ns0:svg.data-production-method: Native outlined type, frame contours, icons, counters and rarity stars; retained artwork, brush materials and logo masks.
ns0:svg.ns0:title: Tapkar, the Speedy

ns0:g.data-treatment: Native translucent tint over current card artwork

ns0:g.aria-label: Not endorsed by Toei Animation or Funimation
When entering Combat as the defender, if
Tapkar has not used another Personality power
this turn, banish the top 6 cards of your Life Deck,
draw 3 cards, and raise your anger 4 levels.
